hello.text: Hi, I'm Lina. I'll talk you through each step while it draws. You can turn my voice off any time.

lesson-1.text: That is the whole shape, in your hand. The next one starts from here.

lesson-2.text: The part you found hard is the part you can now do. That is how it goes.

lesson-3.text: Look at it whole. The lines you hesitated over are the ones holding it up.

lesson-4.text: Same marks, your own hand. That is all drawing ever is.

path-1.text: You know how these are put together now. Try one from life, wherever you find it.

path-2.text: The method carries over. The next path will feel familiar from the first step.

path-3.text: Every one of them finished. None of that was luck.

path-4.text: You have the shape of the subject now. The rest is time with a pen.
